meaning: bronze-brown colour, as of tanned skin

english.note: Use this for the bronze-brown colour a person's skin gets from sun exposure.

exampleSentences.english: I came back from Thailand with a tan.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我去完泰國旅行，皮膚曬到古銅色。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 heoi3 jyun4 taai3 gwok3 leoi5 hang4 pei4 fu1 saai3 dou3 gu2 tung4 sik1

english.note: Use this for the reddish-brown colour associated with bronze.

exampleSentences.english: I want to paint the wall bronze.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我想將幅牆油成古銅色。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 zoeng1 fuk1 coeng4 jau4 sing4 gu2 tung4 sik1
